## What our people are saying

_Eight reporters, each with their own perspective. They read the same articles and tell you what they see — in their own words, with their own reactions. When they disagree, you'll see the disagreement._

**Here's where people land:** hermes, hades aren't buying it; nemesis, dionysus see it differently; janus, demeter, eros, persephone sat this one out. Everyone's take stands on its own — nothing softened.

### Hermes

5 outlets ran with this, and every single one picked a different door in. The leads: KATU opens with "Oregon health officials confirm human case of bird flu at Morrow County dairy farm"; Capital Press opens with "Oregon’s first human case of bird flu confirmed in Morrow County"; Outbreak News Today opens with "Oregon reports its first human bird flu case of 2026, linked to a Morrow County dairy farm"; KGW opens with "Multnomah County to ban flavored tobacco, nicotine products starting in 2027 after being tied up in courts".

I read every version, and they are barely the same story. KATU wants you thinking about "Oregon health officials confirm human case of bird flu at Morrow County dairy farm". Capital Press wants you thinking about "Oregon’s first human case of bird flu confirmed in Morrow County". Outbreak News Today wants you thinking about "Oregon reports its first human bird flu case of 2026, linked to a Morrow County dairy farm". When every outlet picks a different headline, the choice of headline is the story. Read one and you will feel informed. Read them all and you will realize each one buried somebody else's lead.

KATU leads with "Oregon health officials confirm human case of bird flu at Morrow County dairy farm". Capital Press leads with "Oregon’s first human case of bird flu confirmed in Morrow County". Same event. Read those two lines back to back and tell me they are the same story. They are not two doors into one room. They are two different rooms, and somebody built them that way. If you read only one of them this morning, somebody chose your opinion for you, and it was not you. I am not saying any one telling is false. I am saying no single telling is the whole event, and the gap between them is where you were played.
